description: Zero‑dependency, ultra‑fast Node.js framework with type‑safe routing, async middleware, and native HTTP/2/edge support—your modern Express alternative for serverless and edge workloads.
npm_trending_strategy: Version 0.0.190‑daily introduces native HTTP/2, automatic OpenAPI generation, and first‑class compatibility with edge runtimes (Cloudflare Workers, Bun, Deno). The API is TypeScript‑first, providing compile‑time route validation and zero‑runtime overhead. Security is baked in with CSP, rate‑limiting, and helmet‑like headers out of the box, all without pulling a single dependency. These features hit the 2026 trends of edge computing, AI‑ready services, and ultra‑low‑latency micro‑APIs, making the package pop in npm search for “framework”, “routing”, and “express alternative”.
download_hooks: Developers choose Yantravese because it delivers Express‑level simplicity with a 2‑3× speed boost and zero‑dependency footprint.
Performance: Benchmarks show sub‑millisecond request handling on HTTP/2 and edge runtimes, cutting latency for real‑time and AI‑driven APIs.
Developer experience: Type‑safe route definitions, auto‑generated OpenAPI docs, and built‑in security middleware let teams ship features faster with fewer bugs.
